note: Re-judged 2026-11-27 independently against RFC 5216 Section 5.3 (rfc/full/rfc5216.txt). Positive units (TestEAPTLSMutualAuthHandshakeSucceeds, TestRFC5216ServerSendsItsChainWithoutTheRoot, TestRFC5216ServerSendsItsIntermediateButNotTheRoot) added matching ServerIdentity and still prove [leaf, intermediate] without root on the wire and successful peer path validation. Negative units are cleanly isolated: TestEAPTLSPeerRejectsUntrustedServerChain now sets ServerIdentity="rogue-server" (matching untrustedServerCertPEM's CN) and asserts x509.UnknownAuthorityError explicitly; TestRFC5216PeerRefusesAServerChainMissingItsIntermediate sets matching ServerIdentity="eap-tls-deep-server" and asserts x509.UnknownAuthorityError; TestEAPTLSPeerWithoutCARefusesToStart asserts errNoPeerTrustAnchor (which precedes the ServerIdentity guard). Verdict stands: enforced.
